All systems run in Codex CLI as the coding-agent harness with \modelGenBare\ as the generator; API-based scoring uses \modelJudgeBare\ as the primary evaluator.\footnote{We use Luna, which OpenAI positions for fast, cost-sensitive workloads, for high-volume long-form generation and the higher-capability tier, Sol, for evaluation; the shared model family motivates the cross-family check~\citep{openai2026luna,openai2026sol,openai2026gpt56}.}
Holding the generator fixed across systems isolates writing organization rather than base-model capability.

The primary generator and evaluator come from the same model family, which can introduce systematic preference leakage or self-preference~\citep{li2026preference,panickssery2024selfpreference}.
We therefore report the cross-family rescoring described above as a separate descriptive robustness check rather than averaging results from the two evaluators.
replacements.after:
The primary generator and evaluator come from the same model family, which can introduce systematic preference leakage or self-preference~\citep{li2026preference,panickssery2024selfpreference}.
We therefore rescore selected system comparisons with \modelCross\ as a separate descriptive robustness check rather than averaging results from the two evaluators.

replacements.instruction: Add one concrete example of an online Monitor decision after the sentence stating that the process order is not fixed.
replacements.before: Because each decision is made from the updated state, the process order is not fixed: drafting can expose a structural problem that sends control back to planning, and reviewing can trigger another drafting or planning pass.
replacements.after:
Because each decision is made from the updated state, the process order is not fixed: drafting can expose a structural problem that sends control back to planning, and reviewing can trigger another drafting or planning pass.
For example, if \texttt{Reviewing} finds that the draft omits a section the task requires, the \texttt{Monitor} can select \texttt{Planning} to add a goal for that section before further \texttt{Translating}.
